grh_97b9e351c561e9adcb64.title: And Not To Yield
paragraphs: Judy worries about a mysterious elderly man living quietly outside Rivers End with the devoted companion who has cared for him for years. The old man, once successful and well known, is now seriously ill and refuses help. Christian discovers that alcoholism destroyed his marriage long ago. His wife left with their young son Michael, and the ashamed father deliberately disappeared from the boy's life, believing that removing himself was the only decent thing he could still do. He later stopped drinking but remained too proud to seek forgiveness, following Michael's life only through photographs and clippings. Michael, now an Army lieutenant using his mother's surname Hill, has grown up believing his father simply abandoned him. Christian travels to Michael's camp and tells him the truth, arguing that older people can spend years paying inwardly for mistakes they made when they were younger. Michael at first refuses reconciliation, then changes his mind and returns to Rivers End. Father and son are reunited at the sickbed, and the old man's will to live returns with him. Their reconciliation closes with the lines from Tennyson that both remember: though weakened by time and fate, they remain strong in will 'to strive, to seek, to find, and not to yield.'

The surviving recording runs about 25 minutes. The broadcast is also associated with [[org|org.b199d95f77b6c241|Vaseline]].

paragraphs: Crown Prince Karl Franz falls in love with innkeeper's niece Kathy during his student year at Heidelberg, but his father's illness forces him home and ultimately onto the throne.
